zoning.district_source: South Jordan PC staff report 2024-08-13 (PLPP202400077): 'CURRENT ZONING: PC'; 'which is consistent with the P-C zone and adopted Community Structure Plan for Daybreak.'
zoning.min_frontage_source: Adopted 'Design Guidelines/Development Standards - DAYBREAK VILLAGE 12B PLAT 1' (attached to the staff-report packet; staff report: 'The design guidelines, specific to this subdivision are attached for review'). SMALL LOT product (col. C): 'Min. 30\u2032, Max.70\u2033 lot frontage'. Small Lot is the binding/most-permissive detached product used in the plat (approved lots 2,671-10,867 sqft per staff report; lots 101-125 on the plat figure read 2,100-7,325 sqft, consistent with Small Lot / Green Court-Flag dimensions).
zoning.min_lot_area_source: DERIVED (documented, not quoted): Small Lot product states 'Min. 30\u2032 lot frontage' and 'Min. 50\u2032 lot depth' (Design Guidelines, staff-report packet). The guidelines state frontage/depth, not area; 30 ft x 50 ft = 1,500 sqft is the theoretical minimum compliant Small Lot area, used as the pipeline's single-value min_lot_area_sqft. The approved plat's smallest lot is 2,671 sqft (staff report) -- the designer built above the minimum; the pipeline estimates max yield under the stated minimums.
zoning.road_width_source: City of South Jordan Standard Drawings, Drawing S-1 'Road Widths and Border Areas' (https://sjc.utah.gov/DocumentCenter/View/514/Standard-Drawings-PDF): '55-FOOT R.O.W. RESIDENTIAL -- 28\u2032 OF ROAD SURFACE'. Plat interior streets are residential local streets; 28-ft pavement used as the pipeline street corridor.
zoning.source: South Jordan PC staff report 2024-08-13 (PLPP202400077; https://mccmeetingspublic.blob.core.usgovcloudapi.net/sojordanut-meet-e72fea9797d942dea406cf9a66df2c8f/ITEM-Attachment-001-db29936d323c4d84ac6cc6e58e7c07b1.pdf, HTTP 200 verified 2026-09-24) with attached adopted Design Guidelines/Development Standards; South Jordan PC minutes 2024-08-13 (https://www.utah.gov/pmn/files/1160983.pdf); South Jordan Standard Drawings S-1. Per-dimension citations in min_lot_area_source / min_frontage_source / road_width_source.
zoning.source_gap: P-C is a planned-community zone: dimensional control comes from the village-specific adopted Design Guidelines (in the packet), not the base city code -- this is the legitimate controlling source per the staff report. The guidelines define FIVE products (Townhouse / Green Court-Flag / Small / Standard / Large); the pipeline takes a single product's minimums, so the Small Lot product (the binding most-permissive detached product present in the plat) is used. Mixed-product yield effects are a known modeling limitation, recorded here explicitly.

rulegraph.note: 'clean' reflects geometric validation only. RuleGraph verdicts are reported separately with a per-scheme applicable-rule count ('rulegraph_applicable_rules'). A scheme is compliance-confirmed only when its rulegraph verdict is PASS with at least one applicable verified rule. A PASS with zero applicable rules means no verified rule in the store covered the parcel's district — that is 'no applicable verified rules', not a compliance finding.

use_allowance.note: Use-allowance verdicts are machine-evaluated against the human-verified §21A.33 use-table packs: 191 M-1/OS/PL rows (human verdicts by Rohan, 2026-09-23) + 322 MU-5/MU-6/MU-11 rows (batch-verified by Rohan, 2026-09-23; the machine evaluates, never verifies). UNKNOWN never means allowed — it means the use could not be confirmed (no proposed uses supplied, no use rows for the district, no matching verified row, or an ambiguous row such as M1-U-28). MANUAL_REVIEW means a qualifying-provision footnote whose text was not retrieved needs a human read. FAIL rows are blank-cell code facts (the §21A.33 legend: blank = not permitted).
